name: Smerz
label: Escho
lede: Two Oslo friends who moved to Copenhagen, wrote a K-pop closer and a choir piece, and ended up with a 2025 record Pitchfork ranked No. 11.

eras.title: Two Oslo friends, one Copenhagen scene
eras.text: Catharina Stoltenberg and Henriette Motzfeldt met in high school in Oslo, then moved to Copenhagen, where an alt-pop circle formed around them. Their first songs turned up on SoundCloud in 2016.

years.cap: Catharina Stoltenberg and Henriette Motzfeldt of Smerz at Webster Hall in New York City in May 2026 · Wikimedia
years.src: Wikipedia: Smerz · PAPER · Music Musings & Such
years.h: Oslo high school friends move to Copenhagen
years.p: Wikipedia dates the move to 2011. Henriette Motzfeldt studied at the Rhythmic Music Conservatory, where she met [[Erika de Casier|071409d0-ce21-4f03-a111-aec4dbc1590d]], [[ML Buch|e0f9a19e-a929-4a9f-a5dc-82b2d305f03d]], [[Astrid Sonne|bc6af694-5880-4770-bdf1-82d03fea43f4]] and Fine Glindvad.
years.xp:
Catharina Stoltenberg studied math and statistics while Motzfeldt studied music composition, according to a Music Musings & Such profile. The circle they landed in became one of the more talked-about corners of European alt-pop.

Stoltenberg told PAPER: "We developed our whole musical life in Copenhagen. Everyone we know and everywhere we go has some connection to music." Wikipedia notes she is the daughter of former Norwegian prime minister Jens Stoltenberg. The name, per the same profile, comes from the German Herzschmerz, heartache.

years.p: The duo's first recorded song, self-released in 2016, before any label or EP existed.
years.xp: AllMusic dates the duo's formation to 2016 and their recorded debut to "Because". Wikipedia lists it as a self-released SoundCloud single.

years.h: Okey EP: Escho in Denmark, HardUp in the UK
years.p: Their first EP arrived the same year as "Because", through two small labels on two sides of the North Sea.

eras.title: XL comes calling
eras.text: XL Recordings reissued Okey in 2017 and put out Have fun the next year. The duo also started a monthly NTS Radio show.

years.h: XL Recordings re-releases Okey; NTS show begins
years.p: The label that put out Radiohead and FKA twigs signed the duo in 2017. That same year they started a monthly NTS Radio show, still running per Wikipedia.
years.xp: Hypebeast, covering the next EP, noted XL's roster includes Radiohead, Vampire Weekend, Arca and FKA twigs. Wikipedia lists Okey as re-released on XL in 2017.

years.h: Have fun EP, with a self-directed 3D-animated video
years.p: Eight tracks on XL, including the earlier "Oh my my," "No harm" and "Half life." The "Worth It" video used 3D animation by Yilmaz Sen, Natalia Stuyk and Stoltenberg.
years.xp: The Quietus, reviewing Big city life, looked back on Have fun as the record that set the duo's look: art-school minimalism with club music underneath.

eras.title: Believer, and everyone else's hooks
eras.text: A first album, a mixtape, a sample on a Lil Baby single and a K-pop closer in about two years. Smerz became the producers other people called.

years.h: Believer: 17 tracks, XL, trance to violins to rap
years.p: Their debut album ranges across trance, classical, R&B and hip-hop. Pitchfork gave it 7.7; Metacritic lists a 73.
years.xp:
Wikipedia says it was made in remote Norwegian cabins while the pair finished their degrees. The title track's video was directed by Benjamin Barron with costumes by Bror August, and BrooklynVegan called it some of their creepiest music yet.

The same year they released the mixtape Før og etter on their own label, Shopping. Pitchfork put the title track on its list of the best progressive pop of 2021, per Wikipedia.

years.h: Lil Baby and Jeremih's "Stop Playin" samples Smerz's "Flashing"
years.p: A Copenhagen art-pop track ends up under a Lil Baby single. Overmono also sampled Smerz on "If U Ever" and "Good Lies2".

years.h: Smerz produce "ASAP," the closer on NewJeans' Get Up
years.p: Henriette Motzfeldt on the final afternoon of a Copenhagen songwriting camp, where Smerz and Fine Glindvad wrote the closer with Erika de Casier.
years.xp:
Producer 250 had supplied synth loops. "We made the beat from there, and then Fine and Erika wrote melody and lyrics on top of it," Motzfeldt told Crack.

Stoltenberg said the result was "very confusing" and surprised everyone in the room. Motzfeldt says the production is exactly what they made that afternoon, unrevised.

eras.title: A fake pop star and a choir
eras.text: With their own label, Shopping Records, the duo stretched sideways: a concept EP and a piece for a vocal ensemble.

years.h: Allina: eight tracks about a fictional 2000s pop star
years.p: Released on Shopping Records, roughly twelve minutes long. Pitchfork described the glitz of the era with an art-pop edge.

years.h: They write Tidligere den dagen for the Norwegian ensemble GAEA
years.p: A choral piece for a vocal group, released on Shopping, not a pop record at all.

eras.title: Big city life
eras.text: Back on Escho, the Danish label that put out their first EP, Smerz made their loudest-talked-about record: 38 minutes about nights out, written in libraries and apartments.

yt: You got time and I got money
years.h: "A Thousand Lies" and "You got time and I got money" arrive first
years.p: The two singles came in February and March. The second got a video from Benjamin Barron and Bror August Vestbø.

q: These songs were made quite fast, with a focus on the songwriting
years.src: Wikipedia: Big City Life · PAPER · The Quietus · Paste · Line of Best Fit
years.h: Big city life: Pitchfork 8.6, Best New Music, No. 11 of 2025
years.p: Pitchfork called it a slinky postmodern pop album and ranked it No. 11 on its 50 best of 2025, and No. 1 among its best pop albums. Metacritic has an 86.
years.xp:
Recorded across Copenhagen, Oslo and London in 2023 and 2024. Stoltenberg said parts were made in apartments and libraries; Motzfeldt said: "There's something special about making music at a very low volume."

Paste gave it 7.8, Line of Best Fit 8, Clash 8. Robert Barry in The Quietus called it a sequence of half-decisions. A remix set, Big city life Edits, followed on November 5 with Clairo, ML Buch and Erika de Casier.

years.cap: Catharina Stoltenberg and Henriette Motzfeldt of Smerz at Webster Hall in New York City in May 2026 · Wikimedia
years.h: Sky Ferreira walks on at the Regent Theater in Los Angeles
years.p: She joined the duo for "You got time and I got money," carrying a folded sheet of lyrics, one of her rare public appearances that year.
years.xp: Stereogum and Nylon both reported the surprise duet on the duo's fall US tour. Nylon noted she had kept a low profile since announcing her album Masochism in December 2024.

years.h: Easy EP, then opening for Lorde in Los Angeles
years.p: Escho released the Easy EP in 2026, and Wikipedia lists them opening for Lorde on May 14 and 15 in Los Angeles.
